name: smwgraphics-milandra-title-screen
title: Milandra - Title Screen
description:
The cloudy/foggy background from the title screen of Milandra (SNES).

Recommended to use with a disabled or sprite-based status bar, as Layer 3 covers the entire screen height, such as RAM Toggled Status Bar patch, or any option that gives the player an sprite status bar (i.e. Kevin's UberASM retry) or remove it entirely (Remove Status Bar patch).
